emma_fin: Hey team — noticed a weird charge on partner invoice 8234 for Apr 14. Channel partner reported a seat swap (A -> B) mid-cycle but we were billed for both seats for 7 days. Can someone check allocation?
raj_ops: thx emma — can you paste the invoice lines? I can triage usage logs vs marketplace report.
emma_fin: sure, snippet from invoice PDF (redacted):
```
line 42: CHANNEL-ACCT-2345, product: ProSeat, qty: 2, period: Apr 1-30, amount: $400
line 43: ADJ-PRORATE-SWAP, product: ProSeat, qty: -1, period: Apr 14-20, credit: -$50
line 44: MANUAL-CHG, product: ProSeat, qty: 1, period: Apr 14-30, amount: $200
```
seems like they applied a manual charge that duplicates the original seat for the overlap window.
nick_aws: @emma_fin can you confirm partner id & subscription id? I want to pull the marketplace usage CSV to match event timestamps.
emma_fin: partner acct: partner-acct-zz9, subscription: sub-998877
sophia_rev: cc @raj_ops — looks like a midcycle seat swap where the seller did a manual create instead of transfer. We usually request a reclaim/credit from marketplace when that happens.
billing-bot: Automated check: marketplace CSV for sub-998877 shows two seat records for 2026-04-14 through 2026-04-20. Possible duplicate meterlines: MTR-1001 and MTR-1002.
raj_ops: ok pulling logs now. If both meterlines exist we need to open a seller support case and request a billing adjustment. Also flag for finance reconciliation so we don't recognize revenue twice.
emma_fin: what docs do we need to request the adjustment? I can draft the case.
sophia_rev: include the invoice copy, marketplace CSV export, and a short timeline: swap requested Apr 14 09:12, partner created new seat 09:14 while old seat still active until manual cancel Apr 20.
nick_aws: vendor support usually accepts a CSV diff + invoice reference. I'll add the allocation ID from the AWS report: alloc-334455.
raj_ops: routing policy: open case with type "duplicate meterline / seat swap" and request credit for dates Apr14-20 for one seat. Assign to Escalations. I'll add traces to ticket.
emma_fin: drafted the support case, posting here for review: "We observed duplicate seat billing for subscription sub-998877, invoice 8234. See attached invoice lines and marketplace CSV (meterlines MTR-1001, MTR-1002). Requesting credit for duplicate seat from 2026-04-14 to 2026-04-20 ($150)." ok to submit?
sophia_rev: looks good, add expected GL code: REV-ADJ-2026-Q2 in the notes so accounting can route once credit granted.
emma_fin: added GL code and submitted to vendor support. Case id: AWS-CASE-2026-5567. pinging support contact @nick_aws to escalate.
nick_aws: escalating now. ETA from support: 3-5 business days. I also put a hold on recognizing the $150 until resolved (journaling flagged).
raj_ops: thanks everyone. once case resolves update the reconciliation sheet and set revenue hold cleared. I'll follow up in 5 days and update this thread. :thumbsup:
emma_fin: thanks — will update AGILE ticket and close when credit posts. :raised_hands:
